Three reset profiles and native IRQ/RTI/WAI, two mid-ISR joint restores, full architectural CPU/mapped RAM/declared USB/write-prefix replay and retained NVM. Actual SET_CONFIGURATION travels through the production USB/IP transfer-stage decoder and MCU-backed queue. Two joint pending-request restores reproduce both phases, 52 configuration and 64 status/foreground instructions each. General endpoint completion rules are not physical silicon qualification. Ordinary original SETUP still fails after flag acknowledgement before USTB read at address0x033f/PC0xbc3d/CCR0x90. Seven SETOVR lengths independently check original descriptor/copy/clamp DATA1 bytes and ACK before RTI chains into the same retained failure; sixteen pre-read restores preserve CPU/RAM/USB payload knowledge/write-prefix/NVM. Production UsbDeviceProbe repeats the9-instruction refusal through two joint restores without exporting metadata. Three fresh UsbipRuntime attempts return exact12-byte zero-device TCP lists; trusted restore retires old transports without guest mutation. Four decoded suspend/resume changes execute the original7-instruction handler, RTI and foreground WAI; eight mid-handler restores preserve registers/RAM/USB/link/configuration/NVM except documented USSC/RESUMEIE acknowledgement.
